name: Web Threads
description: WebGL2 shader background of glowing sine-wave threads that weave and pinch together, with a draw-in intro, cursor focus on the nearest thread, and click-triggered light surges.
contents: Single container div filling its parent with a WebGL2 canvas inside
Up to 24 glowing threads colored from a gradient palette of up to 6 colors
behavior: Threads animate continuously by phase drift at the given speed
Intro draws each thread in with a staggered head and bead
Hovering near a thread highlights it and dims the others
Clicking sends a light surge along the threads, up to 3 at once
Rendering pauses when off screen or the tab is hidden
Under prefers-reduced-motion the animation, shimmer, intro and click surges are disabled
Canvas resizes with the container and respects the dpr cap
editableByProps: Thread colors, core color, opaque background color, and dark or light rendering mode
Thread count, speed, frequency, spread, taper, position, pinch, node count, angle and mirroring
Glow, falloff, thickness, brightness, opacity, depth twist, traveling pulses, shimmer, edge fade and grain
Intro, hover focus, click surges and pausing
Render resolution cap and container sizing through className and style

needsCodeEdit.change: Raise the thread, color or simultaneous surge limits

needsCodeEdit.where: SURGE_SECONDS, SURGE_STAGGER, STROKE_SECONDS constants and staggerFor function

needsCodeEdit.change: Change hover reach for picking a thread
needsCodeEdit.where: reach values inside the updateFocus function

needsCodeEdit.change: Show a fallback when WebGL2 is unavailable
needsCodeEdit.where: The !gl early return in the useEffect

fixed: Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if unavailable or shader compile fails
Fills its parent (h-full w-full), so the parent needs a defined height
Listens to pointermove and pointerdown on window for the whole page, not only the component
Click surges ignore clicks on links, buttons, inputs and other interactive elements
Effect runs once on mount; settings are read live from a ref, but canvas and GL setup is not recreated
Thread count capped at 24, colors at 6, nodes at 6, surges at 3
Heavy full-screen fragment shader with a per-thread loop; use lower dpr or threadCount on weak mobile devices
Hover focus has no touch equivalent; on touch only the tap surge and animation apply
